cohort: The cohort consisted of 56 very preterm infants (VPIs) born before 32 weeks' gestational age to CMV-seropositive mothers between September 2019 and August 2023.
finding: The incidence of postnatal CMV infection in VPIs born to CMV-seropositive mothers who received breast milk sterilized by Holder pasteurization was 5.4%.
followup_time: up to 36 weeks' corrected gestational age
